NewsArticle.Title: Craft Time 33% Faster
NewsArticle.Content:
Crafts are very popular, yet it is frustrating to remember what time of the day crafts were begun at yesterday, and sometimes not possible to perform a craft at another time.
While it is not practical to set crafting to some times per real-life day, because of time-zone differences of players all over the world, the time for a full cycle has been reduced from 18 hours to 12 hours. This means that if you begin any craft at 3 p.m. your crafting cycle can begin as early as 3 a.m. Of course your cycle does not rebegin until you begin using a craft again, and you can perform up to 18 crafts in your cycle. Any shorter would make it too likely for one to use crafts twice a day; thereby achieving an unfair advantage over you.
Crafts include: Tailoring, Gem Polishing, Elemental Node Cultivation, Enchanting, Herbalism, Higgling, Sword Smithing, Soori Smithing, Ring Smithing, Mentoring, Guiding, Wizardry Research, Hairstyling, Teaching, Worshipping, and Unskilled Labor.
